title: Use theme.colors.getContrastText(color, ratio) instead of a palette's precomputed contrastText for a11y-safe text
answers: Storybook a11y test flags insufficient text contrast on a colored swatch/badge
How should contrast text color be computed on a themed background in Grafana UI?
color.contrastText fails WCAG AA in visual_refresh themes
body:
Symptom: storybook a11y tests report low-contrast text on rich color demo swatches in visual_refresh themes.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ThemeDemos/ThemeDemo.tsx used the palette's static `color.contrastText`, which isn't guaranteed to meet a given WCAG ratio against `color.main` in every theme.
Fix pattern: compute contrast text dynamically with `theme.colors.getContrastText(backgroundColor, minRatio)` (e.g. ratio 4.5 for AA normal text) instead of relying on a precomputed/static contrastText field.
Constraints: apply this when rendering text directly on an arbitrary/dynamic background color; not needed for colors whose contrastText is already guaranteed compliant for all theme variants.
applies: grafana-ui components rendering text on theme rich-color backgrounds (badges, swatches, demos)
